closed_scope: Finite remaining block bodies grouped by actual native API footprint: one ownerless population encounter, canonical hazard/lifecycle refinements, ordinary growth/fluid/light/container/geometry contexts. No Stage policy or later mod.

effects.actual_behavior: Server tick refreshes spawn choice at40+nextInt50 or first migration; migration is original boss-defeated firstTime+24000>gameTime window, first migration shortens previous countdown ceil(old*.25)+100 and prefers Atlatitan. Biome CAVE_CREATURE list falls back to CREATURE; nonempty forced-match list replaces it, otherwise original list retained. Depopulation rolls4+nextInt8/range64 check the PREVIOUS choice; final roll is returned WITHOUT a final blocked check. Thus AMBER_MONOLITH_SKIPS, existing-alive density and pre-boss Atlatitan filters do not guarantee rejection of the last choice. Spawn count nextInt(maxCount-minCount)+minCount excludes max, or min if difference<=0. Countdown mean=max(1000,configured amberMonolithMeanTime), mean/2+nextInt(mean). Atcountdown<=0 requires nearestPlayer28,false, selectedtype and spawnMobs request; successful request sound/regenerate. Each requested member has6attempts, each position20randomtries xz[-10,9]/ground/Ydistance<20/loaded and CAVE_CREATURE sky restriction. TypecanSummon, SPAWNER placement rule and noCollision precede create; entitymustbeMob and CHUNK_GENERATION placement rule, then finalizeSpawn CHUNK_GENERATION with sharedSpawnGroupData and server.addFreshEntityWithPassengers. No owner/team assigned; groupdata is not team. Request flags do not prove actual addition succeeded. Display entity is UNSPAWNED; amber explosion is particles, no explosion damage. Original actor AI/combat/admission stays in its existing family.

Smasher mining/destruction/admission already independently reviewed in R2m8p; no additional living hurt/effect/target. spawnLightningBetween ONLY invokes level.addParticle(QUARRY_BORDER_LIGHTING), no LightningBolt entity/thunderHit. Client borders/spin, block placement/menu-free terrain selection are mining utility; do not infer damage from lightning/smasher names.

Exact native runtime callbacks: Flytrap/PottedFlytrap toggle OPEN and schedule100+nextInt100, no bite; Fiddlehead1/7 grows two-part fern; Cycad/trees native bonemeal/growth; mussel1/20 grows/counts/harvests, sulfur1/10 buds and bud1/3 grows tiers, native acid detection retains terrain relation. GiantSweetberry/PewenBranch survival destroys unsupported terrain; FrostedChocolate reverts to chocolate, no freeze/status. MetalScaffolding supportdistance12 invokes FallingBlockEntity.fall without setHurtsEntities or custom hurt, otherwise destroy/update. GummyRing floating/water/soda and liquid-logging native geometry; updateShape liquid2 unusually schedules ACID while getFluidState returns SODA, native discrepancy retained. Drain moves native source fluids above->below/BFS/removes terrain and schedules20 ticks; no extra hazard payload, original acid/soda consumers stay canonical. Ambersol fills transparent terrain with light blocks until obstruction/build height; no combat entity/effect. ActivatedByAltar DISTANCE1..15/ACTIVE propagation emits only existing WorldEvent1/2 visual messages. NuclearSiren redstone/comparator state and GeothermalVent particle/local sound callbacks only. Native hazards elsewhere are not excluded by this utility scope.

Exact Gingerbarrel/MetalBarrel BE menus/inventory/open counters/NBT and native lid sounds/block OPEN flag. Player interaction PiglinAi admission is separately canonical from the blocks; no second Piglin payload or controller owner. Neighbor/state callbacks retain native container lifecycle.

Exact selected constructors/default state/property definitions, material strength/sounds, shape/collision geometry, placement/rotation/mirror/waterlogging/bucket pickup, loot/resource/tool modification and client particles. Direct call-footprint checked independently: no hurt/addEffect/velocity/target/actor-spawn callback in these selected bodies. IceCream onLand only resets TYPE geometry, no falling damage; Rebar mining removes connected terrain; MagneticActivator emits native directional redstone15, native consumers remain separately canonical. Deferred block/BE factories dispatch to already-reviewed concrete entity bodies, not new effects. Compiler enum tables and sound suppliers retained as original context. Exclusion applies only to exact cited bodies, not arbitrary inherited consumers or other methods.
